title: Unified Focal loss: Generalising Dice and cross entropy-based losses to handle class imbalanced medical image segmentation
mechanism: Compound of asymmetric focal CE and asymmetric focal Tversky with three hyperparameters, generalising Dice, CE, focal and Tversky losses.
adaptation: Replace CE + Dice; asymmetry set to favour crack and inactive recall toward the relR@2 >= 0.90 target, with relP@2 watched as the width check.
min_experiment: Arm Unified Focal (paper defaults) vs SUP100, 5 v 5. Kill if relR@2 not up by 0.02 at relP@2 drop <= 0.05 and crack IoU not better.
evidence: R: imbalanced medical segmentation tasks (884 cites); numbers not read.
